rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the formal vest worn with a suit.

example.english: This suit looks much sharper with the waistcoat.
example.traditional: 呢套西裝配埋件西裝背心，成個人精神好多。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 sai1 zong1 pui3 maai4 gin6 sai1 zong1 bui3 sam1 seng4 go3 jan4 zing1 san4 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this shorter everyday word when the suit context makes clear that you mean a waistcoat rather than another sleeveless garment.

example.english: Your suit jacket is on; don’t forget the waistcoat.
example.traditional: 你件西裝褸都著好喇，唔好漏咗件背心呀。
example.jyutping: nei5 gin6 sai1 zong1 lau1 dou1 zoek3 hou2 laa3 m4 hou2 lau6 zo2 gin6 bui3 sam1 aa3
